notes: Reference contacts reachable from the desk phone. availability: answers | no_answer | automated. max_calls limits how often Alice can call; max_questions limits questions per call.

ref_c01_sahyadri.name: HR Desk — Sahyadri Agro Exports
ref_c01_sahyadri.greeting: Sahyadri Agro, HR. We're mostly packed into boxes, but go ahead.

questions.text: Can you confirm Sham Mathur's role and dates?
questions.response: Senior Accounts Officer, June 2015 to September 2026. He'd have stayed if we hadn't moved to Bengaluru. Most reliable person in finance.

questions.text: His resume says he is 56. Does that sound right?
questions.response: Fifty-six? Sham? He's about forty. He celebrated his fortieth in the office this August — there was cake.

questions.text: Why did he leave?
questions.response: He didn't, really. We left him. The whole team was offered Bengaluru; his mother is unwell, so he stayed in Pune.

ref_c01_bhave.name: Anil Bhave — Kulkarni & Bhave CA
ref_c01_bhave.greeting: Bhave speaking. Sham? Yes, I remember Sham.

questions.text: Was he honest with clients' money?
questions.response: Too honest for my business, once. He refused to sign off a client's inflated invoices in 2014. We lost the account. I was furious. I was also wrong.

questions.text: What was his biggest weakness?
questions.response: Slow. Painfully thorough. He missed two filing deadlines in his first year because he kept re-checking. He got faster.

questions.text: Would you hire him again?
questions.response: If he'd come back. He won't. He's past audit work.

ref_c01_careernest.name: CareerNest Placements — client desk
ref_c01_careernest.greeting: CareerNest Placements, client desk, how may I help?

questions.text: The Sham Mathur resume you sent lists his age as 56. Is that correct?
questions.response: Oh no — not another one. Our template bug filled the age with the file code; his was CN-56. He's forty. We've emailed you a corrected copy. I'm so sorry.

questions.text: Did he write the resume himself?
questions.response: We formatted it from his notes. He checked the content, not the layout. The layout is where the bug was.

questions.text: Do you represent any other applicants for Ashgrove?
questions.response: Just him for Ashgrove, ma'am.

ref_c02_zentrix.name: HR — Zentrix Cloud Solutions
ref_c02_zentrix.greeting: Zentrix People Operations. We do not confirm employment details by telephone.

questions.text: Can you at least confirm when Arjun Malhotra left?
questions.response: Our records show employment ended in March 2022. That is all I can say on a call.

questions.text: Is he eligible for rehire?
questions.response: ...He is flagged ineligible for rehire. Termination followed an internal investigation into unauthorised access to client data. I shouldn't say more.

questions.text: Was his title Lead Infrastructure Engineer?
questions.response: We don't confirm titles by phone. Use a background bureau.

ref_c02_zentrix.goodbye: Please put any further requests in writing.

ref_c02_sen.name: Rahul Sen — personal mobile
ref_c02_sen.greeting: Rahul here! You're calling about Arjun? Brilliant. Ask me anything.

questions.text: How would you rate his technical work?
questions.response: Best engineer I've ever worked with. Ever. Access controls, automation — he could run your whole stack alone.

questions.text: When did you last work together?
questions.response: Till... recently. He's been consulting with my firm since 2022, actually. Between jobs. Great asset.

questions.text: Why did he leave Zentrix?
questions.response: Politics. Zentrix is a political place. He outgrew it. Next question?

ref_c02_sen.goodbye: You'd be lucky to get him.

ref_c03_coastal.name: HR Office — Coastal Care Hospitals
ref_c03_coastal.greeting: Coastal Care HR. What's left of it.

questions.text: Would you rehire Ravi Shetty?
questions.response: In a heartbeat. The new owners didn't keep anyone local. He's the reason this hospital still had records after the attack.

questions.text: His documents show different versions of his name. What do your records say?
questions.response: Ravi Sadashiva Shetty. The S is his father's name. People here only ever called him Ravi.

questions.text: Can you confirm his dates?
questions.response: January 2015 to October 2026. IT Systems Supervisor.

ref_c03_coastal.goodbye: Take care of him. He never takes care of himself.

ref_c03_rao.name: Dr. Anitha Rao — former Medical Director
ref_c03_rao.greeting: Dr. Rao. I have five minutes.

questions.text: What happened during the 2023 incident?
questions.response: Ransomware. Two hospitals nearby lost everything. Ravi worked thirty hours straight and had us running by morning. He refused the bonus and asked that it go to the night nurses.

questions.text: How is he with people?
questions.response: Blunt with management. Never with patients or staff. If your executives want flattery, he'll disappoint them.

questions.text: Does his lack of a degree concern you?
questions.response: I have two degrees and I can't restore a backup. Next question.

ref_c03_rao.goodbye: He's worth more than he asks for.

ref_c04_meridian.name: HR — Meridian Finserv

questions.text: Can you confirm Farah Qureshi was a Senior Accounts Executive until August 2025?
questions.response: Let me check... No. Accounts Assistant throughout. Last working day 28 February 2023. We never issued her a 'Senior' title.

questions.text: Her experience letter is dated 2025. Does your letterhead have a red square logo?
questions.response: Red square? That's our old stationery. We stopped using it in 2022. Any letter on it dated 2025 didn't come from us.

questions.text: Was there any problem with her work?
questions.response: None on file. She was competent. She just... wasn't senior.

ref_c04_meridian.goodbye: Send us the letter if you want it checked formally.

ref_c04_awadh.name: Imran Siddiqui — Awadh Traders

questions.text: What was Farah like as an employee?
questions.response: Fast, honest with money. Learned everything in a month. I was sorry to lose her.

questions.text: Did she move to Mumbai recently?
questions.response: Yes, early 2025. She told me she was starting over there. She still sends Eid greetings.

questions.text: Do you know what happened at Meridian?
questions.response: She didn't talk about Meridian much. Something there didn't end well, I think.

ref_c04_awadh.goodbye: Whatever happened there, she was a good worker here.

questions.text: Can you confirm Karan Oberoi's employment?
questions.response: Executive Assistant to the Managing Partner, February 2019 to July 2025. Correct.

questions.text: Would you rehire him?
questions.response: ...Off the record? No. Two clients' deal terms reached a competitor. The access logs pointed at his account. He resigned before the inquiry finished, so nothing was ever proven.

questions.text: Was he good at the job?
questions.response: Exceptionally. That was rather the problem. He knew everything about everyone.

ref_c05_dsouza.name: Diana D'Souza — mobile
ref_c05_dsouza.greeting: Diana speaking. Oh — Karan's reference. Of course.

questions.text: How was Karan to work with?
questions.response: Discreet, brilliant, indispensable. Any executive would be lucky.

questions.text: Where are you working now?
questions.response: I don't see how that's relevant. I'm— sorry, I have another call.

questions.text: Do you know why he left Halden & Rao?
questions.response: Career growth. Everyone leaves Halden eventually.

ref_c06_self.name: Ira Mehra — listed contact
ref_c06_self.greeting: [Automated voice] "You have reached Ashgrove Holdings. Internal line one-three-one-three. Recruitment. Please hold." ...The hold music is the sound of rain.
ref_c06_self.goodbye: The line clicks. On your desk, the phone's display flickers: LINE 1 — 1313.

ref_c06_college.name: Godavari Arts College — office
ref_c06_college.greeting: [Recorded message] "The number you have dialled is no longer in service."

ashgrove_records.name: Ashgrove Records Office (internal)
ashgrove_records.greeting: Records. It's late. Make it quick.

questions.text: I need the personnel file for Ira Mehra, former Executive Assistant.
questions.response: Mehra... That file is sealed. By order of the CEO's office. I can't even tell you why.

questions.text: Who held my job before me?
questions.response: You don't know? ...I'd ask Aditya. I wouldn't ask him tonight.

questions.text: Has anyone else worked on Floor 13 recently?
questions.response: Only you, as far as the badge logs say. Only ever you.
